log.open.description: The first line of every event file.

log.dropped.description: A range of seq that the writer refused; it explains the gap.

log.rotated.description: A file was closed and a new file started.

native.record.<level>.description: A record of the native library.

page.record.<level>.description: A record of the page, including the errors that a person sees.

sidecar.record.<level>.description: A line that a sidecar wrote to its standard error, stored by the host with the name of the sidecar as the place.

page.console.<method>.description: What the page writes to its console; the text is cut to 8192 bytes while it is built and `truncated` is true when it was cut.

page.trace.<event>.description: The performance trace of the page, while it is on.

host.trace.<event>.description: The performance trace of the host, while it is on.

host.sampler.<event>.description: The sampler of the host, while the trace is on.

host.buffer.dropped.description: A bounded buffer of the host refused a message because it was full; `buffer` names it, `count` is the number of messages (1 for each refusal), `bytes` their size and `reason` the bound that was reached. Not a queue of events, whose loss is `log.dropped`.

page.log.dropped.description: The page queue was full and refused events; the page stores the count in front of the events that follow.

page.start.description: A document of the main page started; a reload starts a new document with a new clock.

page.call.description: A host call of a page; `error` names a refused call.

host.endpoint.call.description: A method that a client of the endpoint called; `args` is the params as received (`null` when absent) cut to 1024 bytes, `error` is the code and the message that the client received.

page.command.description: A command request that the page answered; `error` names a failed command.

host.window.event.description: A window event that the host registered.

host.app.event.description: An application event that the host registered.

host.sidecar.start.description: A sidecar process of standard input and output started.

host.sidecar.connect.description: The host connected to a persistent service.

host.sidecar.disconnect.description: The connection to a persistent service ended.

host.project.removal_allowed.description: A window ended while it was asked whether a project may be removed, so the removal is allowed.

host.workspace.settings.description: A settings file changed; scope is common or the project id, set and removed are the sorted keys joined by commas.

host.notification.event.description: The notification center reported a state or a notice that was posted or activated.

host.test.start.description: A window check marked the start of a test; run is the identifier of the test run.

host.test.end.description: A window check marked the end of a test; result is pass, fail or skip.

host.panic.description: A goroutine or a thread of the host panicked; name is the name that the entrance gave it, text is the panic value (the Rust host prefixes `<file>:<line>: `), and the process ends after the event is stored.

host.update.start.description: The host started the detached command that replaces the application bundle.

native.window.key.description: A window became the key window.

native.window.main.description: A window became the main window.

native.window.occlusion.description: The occlusion state of a window changed.

native.window.first_responder.description: The first responder of a window changed, seen at its next update.

native.input.source_changed.description: The selected keyboard input source changed.

native.input.query.description: A query of the input method that an image region answered; `answer` holds the answer.

native.observe.registered.description: An observer, monitor, key-value observer, run loop observer, dispatch source, Apple event handler or delegate was registered through the native entrance; `registrations` counts the registrations of the source.

native.observe.failed.description: The native entrance refused a registration or a delivery that names no registered source.

native.observe.delivered.description: One delivery of a registration of the mode `record`; `count` is the exact number of deliveries of the source so far.

native.observe.counted.description: The deliveries of a registration of the mode `count` since the earlier summary (at most one per second), their total and the microseconds between the summaries.

native.process.exit_timeout.description: A process did not end within the time that the caller waited for it.
